envVars.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bot token from Discord Developer Portal

envVars.name: CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Application (client) ID from Discord Developer Portal

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level: debug | info | warn | error

envVars.name: DATABASE_URL
envVars.description: Database (PostgreSQL) - points to Docker container hostname

envVars.name: GUILD_ID
envVars.description: (Optional) Guild ID for development - commands deploy instantly to a specific guild

envVars.name: BOT_SYNC_PORT
envVars.description: Port for the bot's internal HTTP cache sync server

envVars.name: BOT_SYNC_SECRET
envVars.description: Must be at least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

envVars.name: BOT_SYNC_URL
envVars.description: URL the dashboard uses to reach the bot's sync server (Docker service name)

envVars.name: DASHBOARD_PORT
envVars.description: Dashboard is disabled if DASHBOARD_CLIENT_SECRET is not set

envVars.name: DASHBOARD_DOMAIN
envVars.description: Caddy reverse proxy domain - set to your domain for automatic TLS

envVars.name: BACKUP_SCHEDULE
envVars.description: Backup schedule (cron expression, default: daily at 2am)
